params.body:
EXPLAIN via #180 on the Stocklist list query:

    dealers range Module2 432
    vehicles ref search_index 55 per dealer
    vehicle_categories ref category_group_id
    export_vehicles ref idx_vehicle_id
    vehicle_dealer_exceptions ALL - 2106 rows  <-- no index at all

The correlated subquery (select count(dealer_id) from vehicle_dealer_exceptions where vehicle_id = vehicles.id and dealer_id = ?) = 0 runs once per candidate vehicle and scanned the full table each time: that is the 700 ms. One composite index (vehicle_id, dealer_id) answers it from the index. Forge runs the migration on deploy; on production it is part of the migrate step.
params.title: Index on vehicle_dealer_exceptions: the missing one behind the slow list
